compute_xnli_accuracy: compute XNLI accuracy by passing predicted and reference labels to the xnli metric
load_xnli_metric: load the XNLI benchmark metric from the HuggingFace evaluate library
calculate_simple_accuracy: calculate simple accuracy by comparing predicted labels against ground truth labels
get_xnli_metric_info: get XNLI metric metadata including description, citation, and input features
evaluate_xnli_predictions: evaluate cross-lingual textual entailment predictions using XNLI accuracy score
